title: IdP compatibility cookbook: deterministic attribute mapping, failover, and audit hooks for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: Produce a pragmatic, IdP-specific compatibility cookbook that documents concrete attribute mappings, assertion expectations, and recommended fallbacks for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping. This ticket covers integration guidance (nameid formats, groups/roles mapping, session handling), audit event surface to support RBAC v2, and admin UX considerations for mapping & troubleshooting. Deliverables: (1) canonical mapping table and JSON templates for our assertion parser, (2) test harness updates (SAML simulator + CI tests), (3) console UI copy and migration notes for admin mapping controls, (4) recommended audit event names and fields for RBAC v2 reconciliation.
comments: 2025-02-10 | Asha Kapoor: Kickoff - scoped with Security and Platform PM. Agreed to prefer deterministic attribute keys (e.g., 'redwood.role', 'redwood.groups') over ambiguous defaults. Action: create canonical mapping and JSON templates for parser.

2025-02-12 | Miguel Santos: Spike complete - Okta provides 'groups' as an array by default; Azure AD requires optional 'groupMembershipClaims' configuration. Observed: Azure may send group IDs instead of names for large tenants (claim overflow). Plan: implement group id->name resolution via graph lookup as optional fallback and mark high-latency in docs.

2025-02-13 | Priya Menon (Security): Decision - we will accept NameID formats 'emailAddress' and 'transient' but prefer persistent 'email' or 'uid' for account linking. For temporary sessions (transient), recommend explicit step-up (reauth) for admin-level operations.

2025-02-14 | Miguel Santos: Added compatibility notes for Google Workspace: Google can deliver custom attributes via the Admin console; mapping examples included. Note about SAMLResponse size limits when groups explode. Suggested mitigation: token gating + group population by SCIM sync for large orgs.

2025-02-15 | Design review (Nina Zhou): Requested clearer UI flows for admins to test IdP mappings from the Console (simulate assertion preview) and to opt into 'resolve group IDs' fallback. Nina asked for inline help text on clock skew tolerance and certificate rotations.

2025-02-16 | QA (Jordan Li): Initial test harness PR #GH-1189 added saml-mock fixtures for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping. Found intermittent failure on Ping transient NameID format; added retry logic and extended clock skew allowance to 120s for test environments. Filing follow-up ticket for production config review.

2025-02-17 | Miguel Santos: Drafted audit event schema. Events to emit: 'sso.login', 'sso.attribute_mismatch', 'sso.group_resolution', 'rbac.role_binding_change', 'admin.mapping_update'. Each event includes: principal_id, idp_provider, assertion_id, mapping_version, outcome (success|warning|error), and correlation_id. Added mapping_version so we can trace failures after admin changes.

2025-02-18 | Asha Kapoor: Security review requested. Putting this ticket up for security_review_required before merge. Attached confluence draft and GH PRs. Noted customer-impact: medium for mis-mapped admin privileges; plan includes manual rollback instructions.

2025-02-18 | Security (Olga Petrov): Quick pass - include additional audit field 'assertion_raw_sha256' to help debug tampered or truncated assertions without storing PII. Also request to redact user.email in logs unless customer allows PII in audit.
